rejected.label: absorbed
rejected.reason: The description portrays an in-the-moment state of absorption during a task, with no words indicating it lasts for months or recurs habitually.
rejected.gloss: This means giving oneself entirely to a task or idea, losing track of time and surroundings, and answering interruptions with a distracted, half-present reply.

rejected.label: beginner
rejected.reason: The description characterizes someone currently new to a craft, with no wording about it lasting for months or recurring as a habitual tendency, so it reads as a current state.
rejected.gloss: This means approaching an unfamiliar craft with eager uncertainty, asking basic questions, making frequent mistakes, and measuring progress in small hard-won steps.

rejected.label: embattled
rejected.reason: The description depicts a current siege of criticism and setbacks, with time markers of days and sleepless nights, but nothing indicates months-long duration or a habitual tendency to fall into this state.
rejected.gloss: This means facing sustained criticism, legal threats or mounting setbacks, spending days in defensive meetings and sleepless nights, and speaking carefully because every word may be used against one.

rejected.label: exanimate
rejected.reason: The description depicts a single state of being lifeless and unresponsive, with no indication of lasting over months or of recurring or being easily fallen into as a trait.
rejected.gloss: This means having no pulse or breath, lying still and unresponsive while the body cools and the world carries on around it, with no more speech, movement or awareness.

rejected.label: flustered
rejected.reason: The description characterizes a momentary reaction (losing composure under pressure, stumbling, then collecting oneself) with no wording about duration, habitual tendency, or ease of recurrence.
rejected.gloss: This means losing composure under pressure, stumbling over words and forgetting what one meant to say, then needing time to collect oneself.

rejected.label: low-spirited
rejected.reason: The description portrays how the person greets one day and behaves in conversation and plans, with no mention of months-long duration or of falling into this state repeatedly or easily.
rejected.gloss: This means greeting the day with a flat, heavy heart, answering questions in a dull voice, and finding little to enjoy in company or plans.

rejected.label: manic
rejected.reason: The description portrays an episode of frantic activity over some days, with no wording about it lasting for months or recurring as a habitual tendency.
rejected.gloss: This means racing through days on too little sleep, talking fast and jumping between plans, and starting projects with frantic energy that soon collapses.

rejected.label: prime
rejected.reason: The description portrays a current state of feeling at one's peak, with no wording about it lasting for months or recurring as a habit, so it reads as a present condition.
rejected.gloss: This means enjoying full strength and quick wits, taking on demanding work and projects with confidence, and feeling that one's abilities are at their height.

rejected.label: tormented
rejected.reason: The description portrays a current episode (lying awake, speaking in strained tones) with no mention of duration spanning months or of recurring or habitual proneness.
rejected.gloss: This means lying awake with dread and self-reproach, unable to put down painful thoughts, and speaking of one's inner pain in raw, strained tones.

rejected.label: untested
rejected.reason: The description characterizes a current state of being new and untested, with nothing saying it goes on over months or recurs as part of the person's habitual make-up.
rejected.gloss: This means being new to the work and never yet having faced a real test of skill, so one's competence stays unproven and one leans on training, questions and quiet hope.

role.label: captive
role.gloss: This means being held against one's will, with each day shaped by a guard's schedule, locked rooms and rationed contact with the outside world, and little choice over anything one does.
role.reason: Imprisonment lasts months or years and it organizes one's whole life, ruling out most professions. It is an imposed role, not a temperament.

role.label: chained
role.gloss: This means living bound at the wrist or ankle by a chain, unable to roam far, depending on captors for food and water, and speaking of freedom as a distant thing.
role.reason: Physical restraint by a captor can last months or years and leaves the person with one overriding identity as a captive, a status so low it rules out most professions.

role.label: condemned
role.gloss: This means living in a cell under a sentence set by the state, counting the days toward a date one cannot change, and speaking of the future only in terms of what is left.
role.reason: Awaiting punishment or execution under sentence can last months or years, imposed from outside. It fills the whole life, so it works as a role.

role.label: does the real task
role.gloss: This means carrying the genuine load of the work, doing the actual tasks while others only appear to, and organizing one's days around the real job rather than the show of it.
role.reason: Carrying the genuine work of a group is a standing position that can last years and organizes a person's whole working life.

role.label: enchained
role.gloss: This means living as a prisoner, shackled and confined, with each day set by guards and a cell, and speaking of freedom as something that belongs to other people.
role.reason: Imprisonment can last years and rules out most professions, so it works as a role. Chains are a physical detail, and the gloss treats captivity generally.

role.label: imprisoned
role.gloss: This means living by the count and the cell schedule, working assigned jobs, keeping one's head down among other inmates, and measuring life by the dates of hearings and parole reviews.
role.reason: A long sentence can last years, and a convict's daily life is organized around the status, which rules out most professions.

role.label: jailed
role.gloss: This means living behind locked doors on fixed counts and schedules, with each day shaped by meals, work details and yard time, and speaking of the outside world as something to be waited for.
role.reason: Imprisonment often lasts months or years and rules out most professions, so it organizes the whole persona as a status.

role.label: learning
role.gloss: This means spending one's days in classes, lessons and practice, measuring progress against exams and skills, and talking of what one is currently mastering.
role.reason: Acquiring knowledge or skill can run for years, as in study or training. A learner in ongoing study is a student, a role that organizes the whole persona.

role.label: minding
role.gloss: This means spending the days watching over a child or a household's animals and property, keeping routines, settling disputes, and reporting each day's events to the people who hired one.
role.reason: Looking after a child, pet or property is an ongoing occupation lasting months or years. It can organize a whole persona as a job.

role.label: prisoned
role.gloss: This means living behind bars under a fixed routine of counts, meals and yard time, with news from outside arriving only through letters and visits.
role.reason: Imprisonment lasts years and is a status that organizes the whole life, ruling out most professions.

role.label: shut-in
role.gloss: This means living largely within one's home, with days shaped by visits, deliveries and phone calls, and speaking of the outside world as something one watches from the window.
role.reason: Being housebound through illness, injury or old age can last months or years and shapes a whole life. It rules out most work and outings, so it works as an identity.

lasting.label: abandoned
lasting.gloss: This means living for months with the sense of having been left behind by those who once stood by, filling empty evenings alone, and speaking of others with a bruised, guarded hurt.
lasting.reason: Being left by others can persist for months, as after a breakup or desertion, but it is imposed from outside and is not a role.

lasting.label: accursed
lasting.gloss: This means living under a doom one believes is fixed, seeing every setback as proof of a curse, and spending the long months braced for the next misfortune and speaking of it as settled fate.
lasting.reason: Living under a curse can last years in a story, but it is imposed from outside, is not a profession, and is not a temperament.

lasting.label: attenuated
lasting.gloss: This means living with a body that has lost strength and reserve, moving slowly, needing help with stairs and heavy tasks, and conserving energy for the few things that matter most.
lasting.reason: Physical frailty from age or illness can last years. It is a bodily condition, not an identity that organizes a whole life.

lasting.label: avoided
lasting.gloss: This means going through each day unseen by former friends and neighbors, who cross the street, decline invitations and fall silent when one enters, leaving meals and evenings alone.
lasting.reason: Being shunned by others can last months or years, but it is imposed by others' reactions rather than a temperament, and is not a role.

lasting.label: barred
lasting.gloss: This means being kept out of a place or activity by a ban, with the locked door or refusal standing between one and something one wants, day after day.
lasting.reason: A ban from a place can last months, though it is imposed from outside and is not an identity. It does not organize a whole persona, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: bereft
lasting.gloss: This means living, month after month, with the death of someone close: grieving the loss daily, returning to memories of them, and finding ordinary pleasures emptied by absence.
lasting.reason: Grief after losing someone close lasts months or longer, and it combines with any profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: blacklisted
lasting.gloss: This means being shut out of work by a list one cannot see or contest, finding offers vanish once an employer checks, and living with doors closed by reputation alone.
lasting.reason: Exclusion by a list can last years and is imposed from outside. It is a lasting condition but does not organise a whole identity like a profession.

lasting.label: broken-hearted
lasting.gloss: This means living with a heavy ache over a lost love, a stretch of months in which the person's thoughts keep returning to them, and ordinary pleasures feel muted and joyless.
lasting.reason: Grief over a lost love often runs for months, and it combines with any profession, so it is a lasting condition but no role.

lasting.label: bullied
lasting.gloss: This means living under repeated taunts, threats and intimidation from others, dreading each day, avoiding certain places, and keeping quiet about it while the harassment continues.
lasting.reason: Repeated harassment from others can run for months and is imposed from outside, so it is lasting but not a role.

lasting.label: cast-out
lasting.gloss: This means living apart from the family or group that has rejected one, going without its support and company, and carrying the hurt of exclusion into every new setting.
lasting.reason: Rejection from a family or group lasts years. It is imposed from outside and is not an office or calling, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: castaway
lasting.gloss: This means living on a remote shore with what the sea left behind, rationing food and water, building shelter and keeping signal fires, and waiting day after day for rescue.
lasting.reason: Being marooned can last months, though it is usually resolved within a story's span. It is situational and does not organize a whole identity.

lasting.label: circumscribed
lasting.gloss: This means living within tight limits set by others: a narrow routine, few choices about where to go or what to do, and daily negotiation over permissions.
lasting.reason: Restrictions imposed from outside, such as house arrest or tight rules, can last months, but they are not an identity that organizes a persona.

lasting.label: clean-cut
lasting.gloss: This means keeping hair trimmed, shirts pressed and face shaved as a settled habit, looking wholesome and tidy wherever one goes.
lasting.reason: A tidy, wholesome appearance is a standing way of looking that can last years, though it does not organize an identity.

lasting.label: contesting
lasting.gloss: This means spending the days on the stump or in the arena, raising money, debating rivals, and measuring each week by polls and turnout until the vote is counted.
lasting.reason: Running in a campaign lasts months, but candidacy is an activity rather than an identity that organizes the whole persona.

lasting.label: decaying
lasting.gloss: This means living with a body that is steadily wasting, with strength, appetite and weight draining away over months, and each day bringing new limits on what one can still do.
lasting.reason: Physical wasting is a progressive process lasting months or years. It is bodily and not an identity that organizes a whole persona, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: dementing
lasting.gloss: This means living with memory slipping away a little more each year: losing names and recent events, repeating questions, and relying on family and notes to get through ordinary days.
lasting.reason: Dementia is a progressive illness lasting years. It is a condition rather than an identity that organizes the whole persona, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: denaturalized
lasting.gloss: This means living without the nationality one once held: carrying papers that no longer confer citizenship, facing the threat of deportation, and having rights and travel plans reshaped by a government's decision.
lasting.reason: Loss of citizenship is a legal status lasting years, but it is an imposed consequence rather than an identity that organizes the whole persona.

lasting.label: discarded
lasting.gloss: This means living with friends and colleagues who no longer call or include one, sitting alone through evenings once shared, and slowly learning to fill the empty hours without them.
lasting.reason: Being cast off by others can last months as friends and colleagues drift away, and it is a social circumstance rather than a role.

lasting.label: disgraced
lasting.gloss: This means living under a damaged reputation, with old colleagues avoiding one, strangers recognizing the scandal, and every new opportunity needing a patient case made for one's character.
lasting.reason: Loss of standing after shameful conduct can last years, but it is a damaged reputation rather than an identity that organizes the whole persona.

lasting.label: dishonored
lasting.gloss: This means carrying a name that others now question, correcting rumors wherever one goes, and watching doors close that once opened easily, while privately rebuilding trust one small act at a time.
lasting.reason: A lost good name can last years, as with disgrace, but it is a condition of standing rather than a role organizing the persona.

lasting.label: drudging
lasting.gloss: This means spending long days on tedious, laborious toil, repeating the same heavy tasks until evening, too worn down to think of anything else.
lasting.reason: Tedious toil on a grinding job can run for months, but it is an imposed situation that fits any profession, so it is no role.

lasting.label: dwindling
lasting.gloss: This means watching one's strength slip month by month, with less energy for old routines, shorter walks and tiring days, and speaking of it plainly as the body fails.
lasting.reason: A slow decline in strength or health from illness or age can last months, though it is a bodily condition, not a temperament.

lasting.label: exempted
lasting.gloss: This means living free of the duties that bind others, such as service, levies or required obligations, and being reminded of that difference whenever peers mention their burdens.
lasting.reason: An exemption from duties can last years, but it is a status that does not organize the whole identity like a profession, office, rank or age.

lasting.label: exiled
lasting.gloss: This means living abroad from one's homeland for years, keeping in touch with home through letters and news, and speaking of the country one left with longing and bitterness.
lasting.reason: Exile from one's homeland lasts years and reshapes life, but it is a status that does not rule out professions or organize the persona like a calling.

lasting.label: expelled
lasting.gloss: This means being out of school or the organization for months, with the record of removal following one everywhere, and spending the days without the routine, friends and standing one once had.
lasting.reason: Being out of school after expulsion can last months, but it is imposed from outside and is not a role that organizes the whole persona.

lasting.label: expiating
lasting.gloss: This means devoting months or years to penance for a past wrong, making amends through deliberate acts, and returning often in speech to the sin one is working to atone for.
lasting.reason: Penance and atonement can run for months or years. It is a course of action, not a profession or office, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: fading
lasting.gloss: This means slowly losing strength over months, with energy draining from ordinary tasks, walks shortening, and the body growing frail while one speaks of getting tired more easily.
lasting.reason: Losing strength and growing frail is a slow decline that typically runs for months or years, usually in old age. It is a lasting condition but does not rule out a profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: fattening
lasting.gloss: This means carrying a steadily rising weight over months, with clothes growing snug, appetite shifting, and remarks about one's new size coming from others and oneself.
lasting.reason: Gaining weight is a gradual process that runs for months, which makes it lasting. It is a bodily change that no role organizes, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: financially constrained
lasting.gloss: This means living on a tight budget for months at a stretch, weighing every purchase, skipping outings, and turning down invitations with a practiced excuse rather than admitting money is short.
lasting.reason: Being short of money can last many months or years. It cuts across all professions, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: fired
lasting.gloss: This means living without a paycheck for months after dismissal, sending out applications week after week, and answering questions about why you left with a guarded, defensive tone.
lasting.reason: Unemployment after dismissal often runs for months. It cuts across professions, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: flourishing
lasting.gloss: This means living in a stretch of good fortune: work going well, relationships deepening, and energy for new projects, so one speaks of plans with easy confidence.
lasting.reason: A stretch of thriving in work and relationships can run for months, beyond a short story. It is a life phase rather than a role.

lasting.label: flowering
lasting.gloss: This means growing through a long season of visible progress, taking on new skills and gaining confidence, and speaking with the openness of someone whose abilities keep unfolding.
lasting.reason: A period of blossoming and developing well can last months or years. It is a phase of growth, not an identity that organizes a whole life.

lasting.label: forsaken
lasting.gloss: This means living with the aftermath of being left by those who promised to stay, keeping a wary distance from new people, and speaking of the desertion with bitterness.
lasting.reason: Being abandoned by those who should have stayed can last months or years after a loss. It is a lasting condition, not a role.

lasting.label: friendless
lasting.gloss: This means going through each day without close companions, eating alone and spending evenings in silence, and feeling quietly left out whenever others mention plans or gatherings.
lasting.reason: Having no friends can persist for years and is not an office or profession, so it organizes no whole identity.

lasting.label: frowsy
lasting.gloss: This means going about with hair uncombed, clothes rumpled and faded, and little attention paid to how one looks, year after year, shrugging off remarks about appearance.
lasting.reason: Being unkempt and dowdy in dress is a standing way of appearing that can last for years. It is not a role.

lasting.label: green
lasting.gloss: This means spending months as the newest hand, asking questions constantly, making visible mistakes, and being treated as someone still learning the work.
lasting.reason: Being new at a job or task is a newcomer phase that lasts several months to a year. It is a status within a field, not an identity that rules out professions.

lasting.label: grieving
lasting.gloss: This means spending months with a loss at the center of each day: missing the person, returning to memories, and finding ordinary pleasures dimmed by sorrow.
lasting.reason: Mourning a loss lasts months, and grief combines with any profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: hagridden
lasting.gloss: This means living for months under a steady dread, rehearsing worst outcomes, startling at small news, and letting worry shorten sleep and conversation.
lasting.reason: Being tormented by anxiety can last months as a stretch of constant worry. It combines with any profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: has legal troubles
lasting.gloss: This means living under pending lawsuits or charges, with lawyers' letters, court dates and unresolved accusations filling the calendar, and every conversation shadowed by worry over outcomes.
lasting.reason: Pending lawsuits or charges can run for months or longer. It is imposed from outside and does not organize a whole identity, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: heart-whole
lasting.gloss: This means keeping romantic feelings light and unbruised, going through relationships without being shattered by loss, and speaking of past romances with ease and no lingering ache.
lasting.reason: Being unhurt by love can persist for years for someone who stays unattached or guarded. It does not organize an identity, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: ill-conditioned
lasting.gloss: This means living with a body that tires on stairs and short walks, avoiding exertion, and planning days around rest because stamina has long been poor.
lasting.reason: Poor physical fitness can persist for months or years. It fits any profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: isolated
lasting.gloss: This means living for months with almost no one to talk to, filling long days alone with routine tasks, and speaking hungrily of the rare visits or calls that break the silence.
lasting.reason: Being without social contact can last months or years, as with a person living alone for long stretches; it is an external condition that a person can be prone to in a way, but the lasting condition is a situation, not a role.

lasting.label: living
lasting.gloss: This means going through each day with a working body and mind, eating, sleeping, working or resting, and taking for granted the ordinary functions that keep one going.
lasting.reason: Being alive is a bodily condition lasting years, but it is not an identity that organizes a persona and no predisposition applies.

lasting.label: maledict
lasting.gloss: This means living under a curse that has been pronounced upon one, carrying its misfortunes in every undertaking, and seeing ill luck follow whatever one tries.
lasting.reason: A curse can persist for years through a story, imposed from outside, and it governs a person's whole fortunes without being a profession.

lasting.label: mastering
lasting.gloss: This means practicing a skill daily, repeating drills until movements feel automatic, and measuring progress against harder goals one has set oneself.
lasting.reason: Gaining command of a skill typically takes months to years, so it is lasting, though it is a process rather than a role.

lasting.label: metamorphosing
lasting.gloss: This means living through a deep reshaping of who one is: old habits and convictions falling away, reactions surprising oneself, and speech carrying the unsettled sense of becoming someone new.
lasting.reason: A profound change of character unfolds over years and organizes no single calling. It is a lasting transition in who one is.

lasting.label: mistreated
lasting.gloss: This means living under the daily cruelty or neglect of people who should be caring for you, flinching at their moods, and measuring every word against what it might cost you.
lasting.reason: Ill treatment by others can run for months under one roof or employer. It is imposed from outside and organizes no profession, so it is no role.

lasting.label: misused
lasting.gloss: This means being used by others who take your time, money or labor and give little back, living with resentment and wariness, and slowly losing faith in those around you.
lasting.reason: Being exploited by others can persist for months under the same circumstances. It is imposed from outside and organizes no profession, so it is no role.

lasting.label: moth-eaten
lasting.gloss: This means keeping clothes and furnishings long past their best, letting frayed cuffs and thinning fabric show, and speaking of worn things with affection rather than replacing them.
lasting.reason: Describes worn-out things that stay worn for years. Applied to a person it means keeping shabby belongings, so the state is lasting, though it is a condition of objects rather than a role.

lasting.label: mourning
lasting.gloss: This means living through the weeks and months after a death, missing the person every day, returning often to memories of them, and finding ordinary pleasures muted by loss.
lasting.reason: Grief over a recent death lasts months, and it combines with any profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: neurasthenic
lasting.gloss: This means living with a persistent drain on energy: getting through ordinary days on reduced stamina, feeling mentally fogged after modest effort, and speaking of being worn out to anyone who asks.
lasting.reason: Nervous exhaustion as a chronic condition can persist for months, and it fits no profession, so it is not a role. Its ordinary name does not suit a trait.

lasting.label: oppressed
lasting.gloss: This means living under a regime of unjust control, with one's choices narrowed by others, constant watchfulness about what one says, and resentment that surfaces in guarded speech and quiet defiance.
lasting.reason: Subjection to unjust control can last years, but it is imposed from outside and is no calling, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: plagued
lasting.gloss: This means living month after month with one problem after another: money, health or family trouble that never quite clears, leaving one tired, short-tempered and always bracing for the next blow.
lasting.reason: Persistent troubles, worries or problems can run for months or years, longer than a story typically spans.

lasting.label: proscribed
lasting.gloss: This means living under a legal ban that outlaws one's group or activities for years, so that every meeting is held in secret and every public word is weighed against the risk of arrest.
lasting.reason: A legal ban on a group or activity imposed from outside can last years. It is not a role, since it does not organize a person's identity.

lasting.label: prospering
lasting.gloss: This means enjoying steady financial success year after year, with money to spare, secure plans and a life that feels comfortable, and speaking of one's good fortune with quiet satisfaction.
lasting.reason: Thriving in life is a condition that can run for years. It is not a calling or office, so it does not organize the whole persona.

lasting.label: revolutionized
lasting.gloss: This means seeing the world through altered eyes years after a change of mind: reading events in new terms, dropping old loyalties, and speaking of former beliefs as something one has outgrown.
lasting.reason: A thorough change in outlook persists for years once it has taken hold. It is not a role, since it does not organize a whole identity.

lasting.label: rusting
lasting.gloss: This means having set a skill aside for months, fumbling through tasks that once came easily, and apologizing for stiff, hesitant work while relearning the basics.
lasting.reason: Skills lapse from disuse over months away from practice, a lasting condition that no profession or role defines.

lasting.label: squalid
lasting.gloss: This means living amid grime, broken fixtures and unwashed clothes, letting rooms and one's own appearance go unkempt, and speaking of the squalor as though it were simply how things are.
lasting.reason: Living in filth and neglect can go on for years, in a slum or a neglected home. It is a lasting condition, not a role.

lasting.label: struggling
lasting.gloss: This means living through a long stretch of hardship, with money, health or work pressing constantly, so that ordinary days go to managing shortfalls, postponing wants, and speaking of getting by.
lasting.reason: A current state of hardship often persists for months, through money, health or work pressure. It is a condition, not a role, so it organizes no identity.

lasting.label: stultified
lasting.gloss: This means spending long months in routine that dulls the mind, answering questions with flat indifference, losing curiosity, and letting days slide past without anything sparking interest or effort.
lasting.reason: Being numbed by routine or restriction builds over months in a dull job or confined life. It is a condition, not a role, so it does not organize the whole identity.

lasting.label: tangled
lasting.gloss: This means living through a knotted romance or entanglement that drags on for months, with contradictory feelings, mixed messages and conversations that circle the same unresolved question.
lasting.reason: A knotted relationship or complicated situation can drag on for months. It is not a role and can attach to any profession.

lasting.label: tended
lasting.gloss: This means living for months under others' care, with nurses or family handling meals, medicine and daily routines, and one's own days shaped by what helpers arrange and allow.
lasting.reason: Long-term dependence on others' care can last months or years. It is imposed from outside and does not define a profession, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: undertreated
lasting.gloss: This means living with a persistent illness whose symptoms flare between rare appointments, managing pain alone with partial remedies, and waiting month after month for care that never quite arrives.
lasting.reason: A chronic condition receiving too little care can persist for months or years, shaping daily life. The condition is imposed by the medical situation, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: uneventful
lasting.gloss: This means living through routine days with few surprises, where the same tasks, places and faces repeat, and where there is little news to share beyond small domestic matters.
lasting.reason: A quiet life with little happening can last years, so it is lasting. It is a life situation rather than a role, and it is not an identity that organizes the persona.

lasting.label: unimpaired
lasting.gloss: This means carrying out work and daily life with full strength, quick reactions and a clear memory, never needing to adjust tasks or ask for help because of one's body or mind.
lasting.reason: Full bodily and mental ability can persist for years. It is a standing condition, not a role, and it is not a temperament.

lasting.label: unknown
lasting.gloss: This means going through public life with no name anyone recognizes, doing one's work out of view, and meeting strangers who have never heard of one or one's work.
lasting.reason: Being unknown to others can persist for years for someone with no public name. It is a standing condition, not a role.

lasting.label: unsuccessful
lasting.gloss: This means living for years without the advancement or recognition one hoped for, working at modestly paid jobs, and measuring each day against goals that never came.
lasting.reason: Failing to achieve success in career or life is a condition lasting years. It combines with any work, so it is not a role.

lasting.label: untraced
lasting.gloss: This means living with a loved one's whereabouts unknown for months or years, waiting for a phone that never rings, and checking every stranger's face against the one that is gone.
lasting.reason: A missing person whose whereabouts are unknown can stay that way for months or years. It is imposed from outside and combines with any life.

lasting.label: vincible
lasting.gloss: This means going through each year knowing one can be beaten, measuring rivals honestly, and keeping a wary, realistic outlook about one's own chances.
lasting.reason: Being capable of defeat is a lasting attribute that holds for years. It is a standing way of seeing one's own chances.

lasting.label: volunteering
lasting.gloss: This means giving several evenings and weekends each week to an organization without pay, while holding down other work, and speaking of the cause with steady commitment.
lasting.reason: Unpaid work for a cause is often sustained over years alongside other work. It is an activity, not an identity that organizes the whole persona.

lasting.label: waning
lasting.gloss: This means finding each week's strength a little less than the last, slowing on stairs and at work, and measuring the days by what the body can no longer manage.
lasting.reason: Declining strength or energy persists for months, as with chronic illness or age. It is not an identity that organizes the persona.

lasting.label: weakening
lasting.gloss: This means watching strength drain from the body month by month: needing help with stairs and jars, sitting down sooner, and speaking of what one used to manage easily.
lasting.reason: Frailty from aging or illness develops over months and then persists. It is a bodily condition no temperament produces, and it does not confer a calling or office.

predisposition.label: bemused
predisposition.gloss: This means finding much of the world slightly baffling, frowning at others' choices and turning over unfamiliar things, and often answering with a puzzled half-smile.
predisposition.reason: Puzzlement passes within hours. People who are often bemused by the world are readily called bemused, so the name fits.

predisposition.label: cheating
predisposition.gloss: This means bending rules and misleading others to win advantage, keeping track of lies, and explaining away shortcuts with a practiced ease.
predisposition.reason: Deceiving for advantage passes within a moment, but a person who habitually cheats is a familiar type, and the ordinary word for that is cheat.

predisposition.label: daydreaming
predisposition.gloss: This means drifting off into private fantasies in the middle of conversations and chores, missing what is said or asked, and coming back to the present with a start.
